candidates.summary: Deathstroke appears. He is hired in Kentucky to eliminate a white supremacist group, then continues fighting zombies; the preview says the Anti-Life virus takes hold when he checks his phone, after which he wakes up choking someone on a street.
candidates.title: DCeased: Unkillables #1
candidates.what_visibly_happens: Deathstroke arrives at a rural house, rings the doorbell, and men in white supremacist gear spill out. He goes inside and is shown cutting down zombies in the foyer. In the preview, he keeps slaughtering the infected, glances at his cellphone, and the techno-organic virus visibly takes hold of his body; he claws at his mask, blacks out, and then wakes up on a crowded street while choking someone. Page numbers were not provided in the retrieved sources.

candidates.summary: Deathstroke appears as part of the 'Anti-Suicide Squad' alongside villains like Vandal Savage, helping organize defenses while the survivors try to protect children from the infected.
candidates.title: DCeased: Unkillables #2
candidates.what_visibly_happens: The retrieved preview and summaries show Deathstroke grouped with Vandal Savage and other villains as they battle the apocalypse. He is described as helping lead the anti-villain coalition while Red Hood and Batgirl shelter in an orphanage. A Fandom summary says Slade is offering Commissioner Gordon leadership of the super-villains. The issue visibly includes the villain team confronting the outbreak, with Deathstroke among them; the retrieved snippets do not provide a tighter panel-by-panel scene breakdown or page numbers.

candidates.summary: Deathstroke appears with the surviving group as they flee toward Poison Ivy’s sanctuary; during the climax, an infected Wonder Woman flies straight through him and blows him apart.
candidates.title: DCeased: Unkillables #3
candidates.what_visibly_happens: The retrieved review summary says the titular group travels to Poison Ivy’s sanctuary. Another source says the survivors are escaping the infected horde with Deathstroke and Jim Gordon acting as father figures to the children. Most importantly, one article states that Wonder Woman flies straight through Deathstroke while he is shooting zombies, and he bursts into body parts on impact. The snippets do not include page numbers, but they clearly describe the visible kill scene.

content.notes: All three issues in the requested closed range appear to feature Deathstroke. sources.title: Unkillables: Deathstroke Annihilates a Batch of White Supremacist ...
snippets:
DC's preview for Tom Taylor and Karl Mostert's DCeased: Unkillables #1 sees Deathstroke taking out a bunch of white supremacist zombies.
Many of the DC Multiverse's greatest heroes died during DCeased, a non-canonical tale in which a techno-virus version of the Anti-Life equation turned its victims into zombies. Unkillables, the sequel to DCeased, will explore more of that event and follow the heroes trying to save the planet. Among those still alive is Slade Wilson/Deathstroke, who in DC's preview for Unkillables takes down a bunch of white supremacist zombies.
In the ensuing pages, the mercenary brutally does away with the zombies. However, towards the end of the confrontation, he looks at a phone screen, which is how the Anti-Life virus spreads. Deathstroke then seemingly undergoes the zombification process, though we know from the first look at the issue that he'll eventually snap out of that state. Although the preview for Unkillables is unlettered, the art is pretty clear that Slade is taking on zombified versions of white supremacists.
WARNING: The following article contains spoilers for DCeased: Unkillables, by Tom Taylor, Karl Mostert, Trevor Scott, Neil Edwards, John Livesay, Rex Lokus, Saida Temofonte, on sale Feb.
The unlettered preview for Unkillables opens with Deathstroke arriving at a house in a seemingly rural area. He rings the doorbell and chaos ensues. Men spill out from the house decked out in white supremacist iconography -- including Confederate flags and World War I-era spiked helmets (Pickelhaube). Once Deathstroke gets inside, he finds a ton of zombies in the foyer.
